title: Skyport Village Friends (そらまちの仲間たち)
style_suffix: Extremely simple and loose Japanese hand-drawn kawaii manga mascot style: thin soft slightly wobbly hand-drawn outline like a gentle pencil sketch, squat pear-shaped soft body, short nubby stub arms, tiny feet, tiny round black dot eyes, each eye with a single tiny round white highlight dot in the upper part, a tiny simple open mouth like a small triangle, faint pink cheek blush, milky pale colors with lots of white and cream, flat minimal shading, no text, no letters.
sizes: Nana and Bruno are the tallest; Pip and Olive are a little smaller; Coco is the smallest.

pip.desc: A small pale-cream hedgehog child with a very round blob body. His back is covered with a soft scalloped border of short round gentle pale-beige bumps. Cream face and belly, empty little paws.
pip.prompt_desc: a small pale-cream hedgehog child with soft pale-beige scalloped spikes on his back

nana.desc: A soft white rabbit child with a very round chubby blob body, short stubby limbs, long upright ears, and a compact face with the tiny dot eyes, tiny pink nose and small mouth gathered near the center.
nana.prompt_desc: a round white rabbit child with long upright ears

coco.desc: A tiny round pale-yellow duckling with a very small orange beak, tiny orange webbed feet, and a little tuft of feathers on top of the head.
coco.prompt_desc: a tiny round pale-yellow duckling with a very small orange beak

bruno.desc: A small bear cub child with a perfectly round circle-shaped face, small round ears, a tiny pale tan muzzle, pale cream fur and a round pale-tan tummy patch.
bruno.role: おっとり・食いしんぼう
bruno.prompt_desc: a small pale-cream bear cub with a perfectly round face and a pale-tan tummy patch

olive.desc: A round pale-cream owl with very thin round wire glasses over tiny dot eyes, drawn very simply with minimal feather detail, small folded pale-beige wings and a tiny simple beak.
olive.prompt_desc: a round pale-cream owl with thin round wire glasses
